page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.9 GHz across an x86_64 architecture. The server provisions 24 dedicated vCPUs spanning 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. System memory totals 96 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4 GB of RAM allocated per vCPU. Hardware instruction support includes AVX, AVX-512, and AVX-512 VNNI, along with cryptographic features such as AES and SHA-NI.

The configuration provides an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is omitted, meaning all storage capacity must be provisioned via external network-attached volumes. In addition, the instance contains no discrete GPU accelerators, focusing its resource profile strictly on standard CPU and memory throughput.

Benchmark results position the instance in the middle tier for compute and memory operations. Stress-ng tests report 1859.78 for single-core and 23314.73 for multi-core throughput, while Geekbench records scores of 1575 for single-core and 12067 for multi-core performance. PassMark evaluations reflect an aggregate CPU score of 28914.01 and a database operations score of 10778.36. Large block memory read bandwidth reaches 133.42 GB/sec, while write operations achieve 65.35 GB/sec. For natural language processing inference, small 135M model text generation achieves a strong rate of 286.19 tokens per second, though 7B model generation drops to 13.32 tokens per second.

Cost efficiency is driven by the instance's balanced CPU-to-memory density without the overhead of bundled physical NVMe drives or accelerator hardware. The server is suited for enterprise backends, CI/CD compilation pipelines, Redis in-memory caching tiers, container orchestration nodes, and static or dynamic web application serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 24 dedicated vCPUs across 12 physical cores, 96 GB of RAM, and 48 MB of L3 cache, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance includes an 8 Gbps baseline network interface, features no local disk storage, and contains zero GPUs. Benchmark scores align with middle-tier performance profiles, showing a PassMark CPU score of 28914.01 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 12067. Memory bandwidth handles up to 133.42 GB/sec on large read blocks, and Redis SET throughput reaches 23.6 million operations per second. With its balanced compute-to-memory ratio and absence of accelerator hardware overhead, it serves general business applications, microservice clusters, Redis caching nodes, and CI/CD compilation workloads.
